description:
Cast Apprentice Necromancer by paying {1}{B}.
Apprentice Necromancer enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes and Inalla.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Apprentice Necromancer with haste.
The token Apprentice Necromancer enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Apprentice Necromancer, adding {B}.
Activate the token Apprentice Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping and sacrificing it, returning the nontoken Apprentice Necromancer from your graveyard to the battlefield with haste.
Repeat from step 2.
